description: A `return` inside a comprehension body raises ol-return-in-comprehension at runtime (spec/execution-model.md:226-227), not ol-return-outside-proc, mirroring #114's checker shape at stage=semantic since execute() now runs check() before Phase 2. Issue #105. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
